project_type: Vite + React SPA with Express backend, Supabase for persistence, Clerk for auth
build_system: Vite (frontend), tsx watch (backend), npm concurrently for dev server
test_framework: No formal test framework detected. Verification via manual testing and `npm run lint` (tsc --noEmit)
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run lint` to ensure TypeScript compilation succeeds. 2. Run `npm run dev` and test manually in the browser at http://localhost:5173. 3. Verify Supabase integration by checking network requests in DevTools and confirming data persists across page refreshes. 4. Test localStorage fallback by clearing VITE_SUPABASE_URL env var and restarting dev server.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None detected. All build artifacts are in dist/ and ignored by git.
environment_constraints: Supabase configured via VITE_SUPABASE_URL, VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY (frontend), SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY (backend). Clerk configured via VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY (frontend), CLERK_SECRET_KEY (backend). Backend runs on port 3000, Vite dev server on port 5173 with proxy to /api. Do not restart the dev server unnecessarily - use tsx watch for hot reload.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code patterns and TypeScript strict mode conventions.
key_patterns: 1. ProjectContext.tsx uses isSupabaseConfigured flag to switch between Supabase API and localStorage fallback. 2. All Supabase writes happen via server.ts endpoints with Clerk auth. 3. localStorage keys are inconsistent: 'omniplane_projects' vs 'vision_projects' - needs standardization. 4. Issue types defined in src/types/index.ts. 5. All modals follow pattern: conditionally render based on state, stopPropagation on modal div, X button to close. 6. User role-based permissions checked via utils/permissions.ts helpers (getUserRoleInProject, canEditIssue, canDeleteProject). 7. Server endpoints follow pattern: flexAuth or requireAuth middleware, upsertClerkUser middleware, Supabase client operations, RLS policies enforced.
directory_structure: Root: package.json, server.ts, .env.local (env vars). src/: main React app (main.tsx, App.tsx). src/context/: ProjectContext.tsx (global state). src/components/: UI components (modals, board, backlog). src/types/: index.ts (TypeScript interfaces). src/lib/: utility modules. .agents/tasks/: task artifacts including Supabase schema SQL.
